scope: 15 native level scenes and all authored action-state snapshots. Resource load calls are separate from textures bound to actual sprites/materials. Actor-frame reachability is included but classified by the separate actor audit. No geometry, rule state, saves or art modified; no GPU quality claim.
provenance: Runtime TracedStage plus actual sprite/material bindings; carry/fountain/background direct consumers added by code inspection. This audit is reachability/resource evidence, not visual acceptance.
generatedNativeNotes: Cloud architecture/flowers/birds/lanterns/waterfall are original SVG via original_cloud_art.gd, not sheet cutouts.
Fountain, gate trim, rain keyboard, optical fixtures, pathway glow and water particles include native SVG/mesh/shader artwork; not automatically cutouts because rendered into ImageTexture.
